source.note: Technical content only. Publisher front/back matter, running heads and printed folios are omitted. Values are as printed; the ASME ellipsis (no value / not permitted) is represented as null. NP = Not Permitted and SPT = Supports Only are kept verbatim where printed.

title: Tabular Values for Figure NFA-9
figure_title: Chart for Determining Shell Thickness of Components Under External Pressure Developed for
value_notation: A is the strain (dimensionless) axis, B the stress axis, printed here in psi -- the unit is taken from each sheet, not assumed (NFN-26 and NFN-27 are set in ksi, every other sheet in psi). ASME prints these in a carried-exponent form -- an exponent is shown only when it changes -- which has been resolved here into absolute values.
